claim: L4 (LFP-primary analysis spec): CSD response to omission, sensory areas V1/V2/V4, stim vs omission side by side. Spec flags this as the primary FF/FB discriminator IF L5 returns an ambiguous result -- L5 has not been run yet, so that contingency is still open.
implementation: context/figures/L4_csd_omission_response/L4_csd_omission_response.py. Reused jnwb.spectral.laplacian_reference (validated in L0 as method (d)'s CSD estimator) and _l_lfp_common's extract_epoch_trials/resolve_area_channel_block/find_probe_for_area (built for L0-L2). Full channel width used per area (64-128 channels), not the 32-channel tractability cap L0-L2 used -- CSD needs real depth resolution.
honest_scope_statement: Spec's own bar for this analysis is 'publication quality, not exploratory quality'. This build is a correct, real, self-tested pipeline -- NOT yet put through the iterative visual-review pass this project's omission-figures skill and context/figures/README.md both require before a figure is publication-quality. Stated explicitly in L4_stats.json's publication_quality_disclaimer field, not implied as done.
layer_label_caveat: This corpus's layer labels (channel_layers_all.csv) resolve to superficial/mid/deep only, not the classical 6-layer histological scheme the spec's 'L1+L5/6 vs L4 sink' language refers to. The figure's layer overlay marks sup/mid/deep boundaries where labelled, not literal layer 4.
visual_qc_finding: Caught on the required look-before-done visual pass (not hidden): topmost/bottommost 1-2 channels in every panel show a uniform full-time-axis high-magnitude band -- laplacian_reference's documented edge-channel treatment (single available neighbor vs two for interior channels) gives boundary channels a different variance/scale. This is a referencing-scheme artifact, not a physiological finding -- noted in L4's README so it isn't mistaken for a real sink/source at the probe's very top/bottom.
self_test: Synthetic voltage with a known localized sink (negative deflection) injected at one channel/time window. laplacian_reference recovered it with correct sign (-1.004, wanted <<0) and no leakage to a channel 4 positions away (0.002, wanted ~0) -- PASS. Determinism and zero-signal finite-output guards also pass.
qualitative_result: V1 and V4: strong, laminar-structured, clearly stim-time-locked sink/source transient ~50-200ms post-p1 -- real current-source dynamics. V2: much sparser response, most of depth range flat. Omission panels: weaker, less temporally sharp structure in all three areas. No FF/FB interpretive claim made -- this figure reports sink/source location, does not interpret it against the classical motif.
runtime: 2m23s for 3 areas x 2 conditions, full channel width.
not_yet_done: L5 (onset latency) not yet run -- so whether L4 needs primary-evidence weight per the spec's own contingency is still open. No human visual-review/iteration pass yet (spec's 'publication quality' bar). No literal layer-4 localization (corpus resolution limit, not a bug).
